title: Fighting Fader
expanded_details:
## Fighting the final boss lets goooo!
## Summoning:
- We still need to find the Alter to summon him.
- We need to get three [[color:rare+icon]Bells[/color]](https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Bell) for the summoning process.
## Attack damage types to focus on:
  - Neutral to: **Blunt**, **Slash**, **Frost**, **Lightning**, and **Poison**
  - Resistant to: [color:orange]Pierce[/color]
  - Immune to: [color:red]Fire, Spirit, Chop, Pickaxe[/color]
## Damage type for each attack style:
**[color:green]Ranged[/color]**: Pick arrows that do statuses like **lightning**/**frost**/**poison**
**[color:purple]Magic[/color]**: Pick the **frost** or **lightning** staff for direct damage. Any **soul** staff should work to do other damage but check the entity damage type
**[color:red]Melee[/color]**: Focus on **Maces**/**Hammers**, **Swords**, or **Lightning**/**Frost** status weapons
## Fader's damage abilities:
A lot of up close attacks that do a lot of **pierce**/**chop**/**pickaxe** damage
Some fire attacks that do **fire**/**spirit**
## What to bring:
- Good armor will be important
- Fire resistance mead will be critical
- There will be more, this is just my list after a first glance
